data.name: Description
data.value: Encode any file to Base64 or decode Base64 back to a file.

data.name: Instructions
data.value: Drop or select a file to encode, or paste Base64 below and choose Decode and save file. Images, PDF and common text encodings are detected automatically, with a matching filename such as decoded.png. Unknown formats default to decoded.bin; you can enter the original extension. Decoding preserves the original file format. Supports files up to 20 MiB, standard Base64, Base64url and Base64 data URLs. All processing stays on this device.

data.name: Encoded
data.value: Encoded {0}. Copy the Base64 text or save it as a text file.

data.name: InvalidBase64
data.value: Invalid Base64. Check for missing characters, incorrect padding or extra text. Data URLs must contain ;base64,.

data.name: SizeLimit
data.value: The file must be 20 MiB or smaller. Base64 input may contain at most 55,924,056 characters, including whitespace and the data URL prefix.

data.name: FileError
data.value: Could not read or save the file. Check file access and available disk space, then try again.

data.name: DetectedFormat
data.value: Detected {0}. Choose where to save the decoded file.

data.name: UnknownFormat
data.value: Unknown file type. Save as decoded.bin, or enter the original extension.
